{{Quote|We're going back to my homeworld&mdash;a place where you first cheated me&mdash;to enjoy ourselves.|Barpotomous Drebble|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 85">[[Star Wars (1977) 85|''Star Wars'' (1977) 85]]</ref>}}
The '''homeworld''' of [[Barpotomous Drebble/Legends|Barpotomous Drebble]] was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located somewhere near [[Keyorin]] and [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]]. Drebble claimed that [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had first cheated him there, which had ignited their long feud.
